subject.title: US House of Representatives, California District 15

text: Representing California’s 15th Congressional district in the U.S. House of Representatives is the greatest honor of my life. I’m running for re-election and ask for your vote based upon my record of delivering results for my constituents, including federal funding for district projects during these most challenging times.

I fought against and voted NO on extreme Republican budget bills that gutted crucial safety net programs while cutting taxes for corporations and billionaires and adding to the national debt. I have pushed back hard against the Trump administration’s inhumane immigration enforcement. Democrats must win back control of Congress to stop a President who ignores the U.S. Constitution and rule of law and sends troops into harm’s way without congressional approval.

I am proud to co-chair the House’s Task Force on Anti-Corruption and Democracy Reform, co-sponsoring one of the most comprehensive voting rights packages in history. We will protect free and fair elections from Trump’s attacks on voting-by-mail, which California has pioneered and I have championed.

I was selected by colleagues to serve on the influential Energy & Commerce Committee where I advocate for consumer and worker protections while growing our innovation economy, directly affecting CA-15’s life sciences and clean energy sectors.

With your support, I will continue to defend and reform our democracy, ensure our communities are ready for climate change, push for an affordable economy that works for all, along with a fiscally responsible federal budget. More than ever, we need experienced leaders in Congress who can beat back authoritarianism so future generations of Americans may inherit a democratic republic.

statement.disclaimer: Statements are volunteered by the candidates and have not been checked for accuracy by any official agency. Statements are printed as submitted. Spelling and grammatical errors have not been corrected.
